flags.message: Ronnie Fenn has two different location values at the same point: “Ronnie Fenn is at Bellamy Road.” (established in Arthur's Counter) and “Ronnie Fenn is at lane behind the Territorial Army drill hall.” (established in The Ballast Announcement). If this is a change, end the earlier one where the new one begins.

Dev acts on “Ronnie Fenn keeps a secret: invented a Zurich protocol requiring fifty pounds of lead ballast strapped to the thigh-harness for the sponsored walk.” here, but does not know it yet — never learns it anywhere in the story. It was established in The Ballast Announcement.
“Marguerite” and “Marguerite Osei” may be the same character. Merge one into the other, or leave them apart.
